//react-router-dom: `npm audit` reports one high advisory here and it is the right trade.
GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 covers 7.12.0 - 8.2.0, but 8.2.0 is not published, so
there is no fixed release to move to. The flaw is in RSC mode, which this
app does not use: it is a client-side BrowserRouter with no server actions.
Staying below the range is worse, not better — 7.11.0 and earlier carry 14
advisories fixed in 7.12-7.18, including open redirect via <Link> and
useNavigate, XSS via open redirects, and RCE in the vendored turbo-stream.
Several of those ARE reachable from plain client-side routing.
Move to >8.2.0 once it ships, and delete this note.
